workflow_runs.name: Scheduled Tasks R2.3 genuine Chrome zoom & focus
workflow_runs.display_title: Keep sidebar regression checks aligned with shared disclosure contracts

head_commit.message:
Keep sidebar regression checks aligned with shared disclosure contracts

Preserve visibility, authorization and destructive-action assertions while matching the public component classes, focus ring and intrinsic icon columns.

Constraint: Main-only scoped integration; preserve parallel runtime changes.
Confidence: high
Scope-risk: narrow
Tested: 33 related Node tests; implementation R19 and R21 CI passed.
Not-tested: Full native width and zoom matrix; independent runtime CI failures remain.
